_comment: Copy to config.json and edit, or set WOOD_ROOT / WOOD_INDEX_DB / WOOD_INBOX / WOOD_TRASH instead. Any key you leave out falls back to the default shown next to it. Run `py -3 studio.py where` to see what resolved.
_library_root: folder that holds your PDF folders. Default: this app's parent, if it contains an _index folder.
_index_db: the SQLite index. Default: <library_root>/_index/index.db. Created on first run.
_inbox: drop folder for new PDFs. Default: <library_root>/new books. Created on first run.
_trash: where a deleted PDF is moved instead of being erased. Default: <library_root>/_trash.
